entities.name: Shanna
entities.description: The captain of the Weatherlight and Sisay's descendant, who has magical immunity and who faces nightmares to save her crew.

entities.name: Tiana
entities.description: An angelic artificer of the Weatherlight crew who fears the disguised ship is breaking and cuts out its powerstone.

entities.name: Raff Capashen
entities.description: An illusionist and wizard who flies the Weatherlight, senses the magic in the mountains and helps defeat Shard-Braids.

entities.name: Arvad
entities.description: A Weatherlight crew member left in charge during the mission, who survives the attack on the way back.

entities.name: Velena
entities.description: The weapons officer of the Weatherlight, who is killed by the corrupted ship's powerbolts.

entities.name: Elmegraun
entities.description: A Weatherlight engine room crew member killed by the corrupted ship.

entities.name: Botono
entities.description: The helmsman injured by the dragon and later appears as a Phyrexian tentacle head in a nightmarish engine room.

entities.name: Ulaten
entities.description: A newer cockpit crew member who carried Botono and appears as a tentacle head.

entities.name: Anyxni
entities.description: A newer cockpit crew member who carried Botono and appears as a tentacle head.

entities.name: Slimefoot
entities.description: A thallid who clings to the Weatherlight's powerstone and is rescued by Shanna and Tiana.

entities.name: Braids
entities.description: A shadowy, braided, many-handed being who helps the crew enter a nightmare barrier in return for help reabsorbing her shard-self.

entities.name: Shard-Braids
entities.description: A split-off shard of Braids hiding in the nightmare barrier, who attacks the crew and is reabsorbed.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: The ancestor and former captain of the Weatherlight, whose example Shanna tries to live up to.

entities.name: Nightmare Sisay
entities.description: A half-flesh, half-bone nightmare version of Sisay that mocks Shanna and is destroyed.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: A former Weatherlight captain whose judgement Shanna imagines.

entities.name: Ilsa Braven
entities.description: A former Weatherlight captain whose judgement Shanna imagines.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: The Phyrexian whom Sisay helped destroy.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: The praetor whose territory the Weatherlight flies over in disguise.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: A skyship covered in Phyrexian garbage as camouflage, which becomes Phyrexian-corrupted and flies away.

entities.name: Skeletal dragon
entities.description: A reanimated dragon guarding a hoardgrave that attacks the Weatherlight and is shot down.

entities.name: Nightmare barrier
entities.description: A dome of roiling black smoke that shows each person their nightmares and hides a Phyrexian war construct and Shard-Braids.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders whose war construct tore open the dragon's hoardgrave.

entities.name: Coalition
entities.description: The alliance for which the Weatherlight carries deliveries.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: The region of Dominaria where the Weatherlight crash-lands.

entities.name: Pardia
entities.description: A region near the crash site that Raff jokes they could have landed in.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane under Phyrexian invasion.

events.summary: Tiana warns Shanna that the Phyrexian disguise is damaging the Weatherlight, then a screech signals an attack.
events.quote: A screech like nothing Shanna had heard sliced through the air

events.summary: A skeletal dragon attacks the Weatherlight, injuring Botono, and a lance tears a hole in the starboard wing.
events.quote: one of the lances from tearing a hole in the starboard wing

events.summary: Velena's powerbolts sever the dragon's wing and it falls, but the Weatherlight must land.
events.quote: The dragon howled and plummeted out of the sky.

events.summary: The crew finds the Weatherlight grounded in Otaria with cracked moderator rods, and Raff proposes seeking magic in the mountains.
events.quote: "I think that dragon was guarding something," Raff said.

events.summary: Shanna, Raff and Tiana find a smoky, magic-eating barrier, and Braids appears and offers help if they kill her shard-self.
events.quote: "I help you get inside the barricade, and you help me kill me."

events.summary: Braids opens four corridors in the barrier, and each of the three walks through alone.
events.quote: Four gaps had opened in the barrier, smooth sided and narrow.

events.summary: Shanna confronts a nightmare Sisay who mocks her legacy and shows her visions of her friends dying; Shanna destroys it.
events.quote: There was no artistry to Shanna's assault, only brutality.

events.summary: The three emerge on the other side at different times and find the Phyrexian war construct sunk in a crater.
events.quote: the half-sunken hulk of a Phyrexian war machine

events.summary: Shard-Braids attacks the crew, Braids returns, and together they defeat the shard, which Braids absorbs.
events.quote: like an avalanche that buried the shard whole.

events.summary: Braids reveals she was holding the shard back, and Tiana starts gathering parts from the war construct.
events.quote: I think . . . I need to start gathering parts."

events.summary: On the way back, Velena, Arvad and Elmegraun arrive and the corrupted Weatherlight rains powerbolts, killing Velena and Elmegraun.
events.quote: Velena and Elmegraun weren't so lucky and melted into puddles

events.summary: The Weatherlight has become a Phyrexian monstrosity, and Shanna and Tiana enter to recover the powerstone.
events.quote: a glance was enough to know it wasn't the Weatherlight anymore.

events.summary: Inside, Shanna destroys tentacles wearing the heads of Botono, Ulaten and Anyxni and frees Slimefoot and the powerstone.
events.quote: One thrust, and Botono's death was final

events.summary: Shanna, Tiana and Slimefoot escape the ship, which flies away in its transformed state.
events.quote: Tiana squeezed Shanna and Slimefoot close and leapt out of the hatch.

relations.quote: The most regular reminder of her ancestor's deeds
"We can talk about how fun it would've been once we're at a safe port," Shanna said.

relations.note: Raff pilots and obeys the captain.
Shard-Braids is a split-off piece of Braids she wants to reabsorb.
relations.quote: All you need to know is that I need to reabsorb that version of myself.

relations.note: A reluctant bargain: Braids helps them get in and they help her.
relations.quote: she hadn't tried to kill them yet.

relations.note: Attacks the ship and is shot down.
relations.quote: Another screech slammed against the Weatherlight 's hull

relations.note: The ship has been corrupted into a Phyrexian monstrosity.
relations.quote: said the Weatherlight she knew was dead

relations.note: Rescued by Tiana and Shanna from the engine room.
relations.quote: Tiana squeezed Shanna and Slimefoot close and leapt out of the hatch.
